summary: Phase G — Overcharge Alerts validated end-to-end on backend + mobile. Backend GET /api/invoices/overcharge-alerts returns count=2 for cathy with both seeded providers (Glorious Services Pty Ltd flagged 14/14; Meridian Home Care Pty Ltd flagged 10/10) and the expected overcharge codes (C1, C2, C4, C6, C11, C12); 401 without auth; route ordering intact (GET /api/invoices/<bogus> still 404). Mobile /invoices renders the OverchargeAlerts banner (testID overcharge-alerts) with overcharge-alert-0/1, overcharge-count-0/1, and overcharge-view-0/1; tapping overcharge-view-1 filters the list to Meridian. For a user with no flagged invoices (trialactive@example.com), the banner is correctly hidden. Web banner was pre-verified by the main agent; I did not re-screenshot web.
critical_code_review_comments: OverchargeAlerts (mobile + web): 404/500 from the endpoint is silently swallowed (.catch(() => {})). That is deliberate (non-blocking), but consider a debug log so an accidental route regression doesn't disappear.
Backend list_invoices caps items at 50 while overcharge-alerts iterates ALL active invoices unbounded. Fine now (cathy has 39), but worth adding a soft limit if invoice-per-user grows significantly.

_oc_amount uses abs(financial_impact.amount); if a finding stores a negative refund amount as its impact, this correctly counts it as overcharge magnitude. Confirm findings never overload the field with non-currency values.
test_credentials: cathy@example.com / testpass123 (2 repeated-overcharge providers); trialactive@example.com / AccessTest1! (hide-when-empty case)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Mobile Expo web preview host is https://final-verify-web.expo.preview.emergentagent.com — different from web preview. The overcharge banner appears ABOVE Smart AI Summary on /invoices and the 'Show' pill wires to setProviderFilter (mobile) / setSelectedProviders (web). For cathy, expect 2 alerts; for trialactive, expect the component to return null.
